metaDescription: Kevin explains why he does not see himself as a traditional conspiracy theorist, citing his belief that Sam Altman is plotting harm.
summary: Kevin says he does not consider himself a traditional conspiracy theorist and is not interested in topics like aliens or pyramids. He explains that his focus is on the idea that bad people get together and plot harmful things. As an example, he says he believes Sam Altman is an evil person plotting to kill us all, while noting that others would simply call Altman an evil, psychopathic billionaire.
